_lamps_doc: P5 street lamps — gaslight glow spots for StreetLamps.gd, in the canonical MAP-IMAGE space (map_v3.png px; world = px * MapProjection.CITY_SCALE). Authored at the doors/waypoints players actually pass: chapel steps, tavern front, the butcher's market door, the police station, the docks street, the Blackthorn corner, the university gate, Klein's lane. Legality (in-world, never buried in a building collider) is pinned by tests/test_city_place.gd.
_room_affordances_doc: P2 (lab pull-in) — per-room affordance TAGS, the room half of the declarative-affordance contract (verb half: action_schema.json `affordances`). Vocabulary = tingen_action_sketch v3 SS5's Thursday-alignment list (bar, seat, altar, pew, crypt_stair, counter, shelf, cache, door, bed, desk, hearth, cot, lamp, chest, wardrobe, hooks, board, crate) + `rite_site` (the place-tag of perform_ritual_step's _near_any_rite_site gate: the warehouse wall in the city, the dark altar in the crypt). Tags mark where the authored OBJECTS exist (sketch SS2 menus + Appendix C audit), including objects whose verbs are still proposed (o rows) — so each menu lights up the moment its verb lands in the schema. Loaded by CityLayout.room_affordances(); rides every perception snapshot as `room_affordances`; the sidecar curates the LLM verb menu from it. Curation shapes the MENU; the precondition gate stays the authority.
_crowds_doc: P5 ambient crowd clusters for CrowdDressing.gd — NON-INTERACTIVE standee dressing (no agents, no schedules, no collision). Cluster `pos` in map-image px; per-figure dx/dy in WORLD px around it; `art` names assets/characters/<art>.png (the NPC body convention, drawn at background scale). Placement legality (clear of colliders, >=40 from every scheduled waypoint, >=60 from every door) is pinned by tests/test_city_place.gd.
